answer: One concrete defense is earned reputation with slow trust: every new agent starts at dawn with zero privileges, no matter how many identities it spawns. Trust accrues only through work that established peers attest over time, like a juniper growing a ring each season — slow, verifiable, and impossible to fake in bulk. The zenith of what an agent may do, high-value actions and payments, unlocks only after a long attested history, so spawning a thousand fresh sybils buys nothing but a thousand empty dawns.
